question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"expressions."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Expressions"** refers to the way someone communicates their thoughts or emotions through words, gestures, or facial expressions. (विचारों या भावनाओं की अभिव्‍यक्ति) • **Example**: *Freedom of **expression**__ is a basic human right.* • In this context, it is likely referring to the way someone expresses their criticism. • Grammatically, **"expressions"** is a noun and fits appropriately in the blank space. • The correct answer is option 3. • Correct passage: Today, I want to talk to you about a very simple matter, that is, simple conversations. When we learn to speak, __first__ come words, then phrases, and then scripts. You would agree that the larger the bundles of words we __carry around__, the less we have to worry about combining them into sensible __**expressions**__. Also the less we have to fret over syntax or ______ (4) ______. Do you think you choose the words? Do you pre-rehearse every time you go out? ______ (5) ______ what happens when you walk into a fast-food restaurant. My dear, how do you react in those real life situations? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Executions"** refers to the act of carrying out a plan, often in a legal or military context. (मृत्‍युदंड, फाँसी; अमल, लागूकरण, निष्पादन) • **"Traits"** refers to a distinguishing characteristic or quality of a person or thing. (किसी व्‍यक्ति के चरित्र या व्‍यक्तित्‍व की विशेषता) • **"Criticism"** is already listed as an option and does not require additional explanation. (आलोचना, निंदा, दोषन्‍वेषण) 45:Tf74, The correct answer is **"grammar."**
